investments.company_description: Lovable operates a software creation platform that lets people build applications without extensive technical training, using AI to generate apps from natural language. It is headquartered in Stockholm.

River AI is a full-stack AI research company building open-weight models whose weights are freely downloadable. Its first product, the River API, lets developers fine-tune open-weight models on their own data without needing a dedicated AI team or large-lab infrastructure.

Vals AI builds independent benchmarks and evaluations that measure how well large language models and AI systems perform on real, domain-specific professional tasks such as legal, finance, and tax work. It gives enterprises data to compare models and AI products before deploying them.

Flagler Health builds AI software for musculoskeletal care clinics that integrates with existing electronic medical records to automate patient triage, care management, patient outreach and call handling, and revenue cycle tasks like prior authorization, coding, and billing. It is used by thousands of providers across more than 36 states.
investments.sub_sector: AI clinical and administrative workflow software for musculoskeletal care

investments.company_description: FSH Technologies builds custom software for city and county governments, delivered in weeks rather than years on a shared underlying platform. It also operates a proprietary system to track and respond to government software RFPs at scale.
investments.sub_sector: GovTech / state and local government software

investments.company_description: Etched designs purpose-built inference chips and full rack-scale systems—including networking, switching, cooling, power, and software—optimized for running transformer-based AI models efficiently. It aims to maximize tokens produced per dollar and per watt for AI inference workloads.
investments.notes: Reported undisclosed, but the post contains $1 billion; verify against the source.
investments.sub_sector: AI inference chips and rack-scale systems

investments.company_description: Preview is an AI-native video creation and production platform for professional creators, combining a video timeline with an infinite canvas in a collaborative multiplayer workspace. It lets teams generate footage with any AI model while tracking characters, locations, props and the provenance of every asset.
investments.notes: Reported undisclosed, but the post contains $100M; verify against the source.
investments.sub_sector: Generative video creation and production tooling

investments.company_description: Corma is training a foundation model specialized for defensive cybersecurity, using large-scale reinforcement learning in simulated enterprise network environments. Its model powers an agentic 'Security Workforce' that detects, contains and remediates attacks across enterprise security tools.
investments.sub_sector: AI foundation model for defensive cybersecurity

investments.company_description: Etched designs custom silicon and cluster-scale systems purpose-built for AI inference, specializing in running transformer and other frontier model architectures. Its first-generation chip was taped out at TSMC and is shipping to early customers in 2026.

Bunkerhill Health builds a platform, Carebricks, that lets hospitals and health systems create and deploy AI agents for clinical, operational, and administrative tasks using data the hospital already generates. It originally focused on taking research AI models through validation and FDA clearance into bedside use.
investments.sub_sector: Clinical AI agents for health systems

investments.company_description: Sable builds an AI employee called 'Aidan' that runs customer calls on its own, using voice, video, real-time vision and live browser interaction to demonstrate and explain a company's product to prospects.
investments.sub_sector: AI sales agents / customer-facing AI employees

investments.company_description: Twin1 builds a governed context layer for enterprises by giving each knowledge worker a digital 'Twin' — a model of their expertise and judgment that answers colleagues' questions inside Slack, Teams, and email while respecting their privacy and permission preferences. Networked together, these Twins let people and AI agents query organizational knowledge without bypassing its owners.
investments.sub_sector: Enterprise knowledge management and AI governance

investments.company_description: Keenable is building a web index and search infrastructure designed specifically for AI agents rather than human users. It offers a web-query language and a real-time search API that let agents retrieve and reason over thousands of live sources quickly and cheaply.

Gimlet Labs operates a multi-silicon inference cloud that runs AI inference workloads across mixed hardware — GPUs, CPUs, and purpose-built accelerators — using a compiler and runtime that split and route work to the best-suited processor. Developers access it through a single inference API, and the company also handles data center-level differences in networking, power, and cooling.
investments.notes: Reported undisclosed, but the post contains $1; verify against the source.

investments.company_description: Atira builds an AI system that helps industrial manufacturers respond to complex sales inquiries by reading unstructured customer specifications, configuring suitable product solutions, and generating the required quote and compliance documentation. It connects to existing CRM and ERP systems to run the commercial response process end to end.
investments.notes: Reported undisclosed, but the post contains $128B; verify against the source.
investments.sub_sector: AI for industrial sales engineering / manufacturing quoting

investments.company_description: Wonderful builds an AI operating system for large enterprises, providing a shared layer that coordinates AI agents, workflows, applications, enterprise context, and integrations. It is model-agnostic and deploys with enterprise customers across many countries.

Highstock operates an AI-powered B2B marketplace that connects consumer brands holding excess inventory with vetted global wholesale buyers. It handles matching, pricing, logistics, compliance, payments, and order paperwork so brands can offload overstock discreetly.

Cognition is the company behind Devin, an autonomous AI software engineer that runs in its own sandboxed cloud environment, takes a written specification or ticket, and plans, writes, and tests code before returning it for review. It sells primarily to large enterprises for work like code modernizations, migrations, and refactors.

Lightfield is an AI-native CRM that automatically builds a customer data model from a company's emails and calls, using a temporal context graph to track deals. It includes agents that handle record updates, follow-ups, handoffs, and reporting, with pricing based on work done rather than per-seat.

Antioch builds a simulation platform for physical AI, calibrating high-fidelity simulations to customers' hardware using real-world data and running them at cloud scale. Robotics, drone, and autonomous system teams use it to run thousands of parallel tests and validate models before deployment.
investments.sub_sector: Simulation and testing infrastructure for robotics and autonomous systems

investments.company_description: Mistral is a Paris-based AI company that builds frontier large language models and provides enterprises with full-stack AI infrastructure, including compute, model customization, and agent-based workflows, with an emphasis on data control and sovereignty.

Harvey builds AI software for law firms and in-house legal teams, letting them apply large language models to legal work using their own documents, precedents, and institutional knowledge. Its platform includes domain-specific agents, workflow tools, and controls for data security and auditability.

Cylake builds an appliance-based security platform that runs inside a customer's own data center, consolidating all security data into a single data lake with security functions delivered as applications on top. It uses machine learning and LLMs running on customer-owned hardware to detect, investigate, and remediate threats for enterprises that can't send data to the cloud.
investments.sub_sector: Enterprise security platform / on-premise AI security

investments.company_description: Mistral AI is a French artificial intelligence company that builds large language models, many with open weights, and sells enterprise AI deployment tools and infrastructure. Its products include the Mistral 7B and Mixtral models, Mistral OCR, Voxtral, and European Compute Units for sovereign compute capacity.

Neo (Neo Security) builds an endpoint security platform designed specifically to discover, monitor, and enforce policy on AI agents and agentic software running on employee devices. It deploys a sensor on the endpoint that observes agent traffic and lets security teams create guardrails using plain language.
